bsa_title: Opinions of experts (Examiner of Electronic Evidence)
evidentiary_effect: Includes opinion of Examiner of Electronic Evidence referred to in Section 79A of Information Technology Act 2000.
Document includes electronic and digital records, microfilms, server logs, smartphone messages, cloud storage records, and emails.
Includes oral accounts of document contents, written admissions, counterpart documents, and digital copies produced by mechanical processes.

iea_title: Birth during marriage conclusive proof of legitimacy
evidentiary_effect: Conclusive proof of legitimacy retained if born during valid marriage or within 280 days after dissolution.

iea_title: Presumption as to abetment of suicide by a married woman
bsa_title: Presumption as to abetment of suicide
evidentiary_effect: Presumption of abetment of suicide within 7 years of marriage upon proof of cruelty by husband or relatives.
Presumption of dowry death where woman subjected to cruelty or harassment soon before her death for dowry demand.

iea_title: Presumption as to absence of consent in certain prosecutions for rape
bsa_title: Presumption as to absence of consent
evidentiary_effect: Court shall presume lack of consent if victim states in testimony that she did not consent.
